verdict.rationale: LocalAI's own getting-started docs give an official container image and a `docker run` command, so running the runtime in a container is a first-party capability. The reproducibility half of the story is thin: the only documented example uses the floating `latest` tag. PRELOAD_MODELS (`--preload-models`) offers declarative model setup, but its docs never tie it to containers. missing for 10: documented version-pinned image tags or digests, compose/Kubernetes deployment guidance, GPU-variant container images, persistent volume/model-path configuration for containers, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run the runtime inside a container for reproducible deployment

citations.quote: PRELOAD_MODELS (or --preload-models) takes a list in JSON with the same parameter of the API calls of the /models/apply endpoint.
